process.label: How It Works
process.title: From Question Bank to Results
process.subtitle: Four steps from a teacher writing questions to results ready to share.

steps.title: Build a Question Bank
steps.desc: Write questions manually or generate them with AI — dozens of multiple-choice and essay questions ready in seconds.

steps.title: Schedule the Exam
steps.desc: Set the start time, duration, and which classes take part. Students get access the moment the exam opens.

steps.title: Students Take the Exam
steps.desc: Kiosk mode locks each student's Android device — no other apps, no leaving the exam screen.

steps.title: Results, Instantly
steps.desc: Multiple-choice answers are graded automatically the moment the exam ends. Teachers see results per student and per class right away.

dashboard.title: Watch the Exam, Second by Second
dashboard.subtitle: Every student device stays connected live over WebSocket — teachers see who's online, who's finished, and get an instant alert if anything looks suspicious.

trust.label: Built for Indonesian Schools
trust.title: Realistic for Everyday School Conditions
trust.subtitle: CBT Pro is designed around the real constraints Indonesian schools face, not idealized assumptions.

points.title: Works on Limited Bandwidth
points.desc: Optimized for constrained school connections — exams run smoothly without high-speed internet.

points.title: Works with Shared Devices
points.desc: Supports staggered exam sessions for schools that don't yet have one device per student.

points.title: Fully Indonesian-Language Support
points.desc: Interface, notifications, and customer support are entirely in Indonesian — no confusing technical jargon.

closingCta.title: Try CBT Pro Free
closingCta.subtitle: Sign up your school and run your first anti-cheat online exam in minutes.
